Production signals

Facts about who made the game and how players received it. They don't depend on AI, and they help tell a carefully made game that used some AI apart from mass-produced ones.

  • Wild Forest Studio released 1 game on Steam in the last 12 months. 1 of their 2 games disclose AI.

  • 328 player reviews, 70% positive (Mostly Positive).
  • Our AI review of these signals: solid production.

What the developer says

Generative AI is used only to assist with localization/translation. All localized text is reviewed and edited by the developer. No AI-generated art, audio, or in-game live generation is used.

From the “AI Generated Content Disclosure” on the Steam store page, quoted as written. First seen by us on Oct 28, 2026.

Reasoning

The disclosure limits AI to localization/translation, which is a supporting task, not shipped game content. No AI art, audio, or live generation is declared. The developer has one recent release and 328 reviews, showing a normal production cadence.

Against: Localized text is player-visible, so AI touches something players read, though it is reviewed and edited by the developer.

FAQ

Does Dragon Shelter use AI?

Yes. Dragon Shelter's developer discloses AI-generated content on its Steam page. AI was used only to assist with localization and translation; all in-game art, audio, and gameplay are human-made.

Is Dragon Shelter AI-generated?

Only partly. AI is used in minor ways, such as store images, translation or small details.

How does GameAICheck know?

We read the AI Generated Content Disclosure from the game's public Steam store page, check it daily, and show what independent curators and open-source tools say about it. Disclosures are self-reported by developers.

Is something wrong?

Developers and players can dispute or report this page. We review every message and correct mistakes.
